title: AI-ECG potassium to triage haemolysed hyperkalaemia: analysis code
description: Analysis code for an electrocardiogram-based deep learning potassium estimate to distinguish haemolytic pseudohyperkalaemia from true hyperkalaemia (development on HEEDB, external validation on MIMIC-IV). Code only: no patient data, record-level derivatives or model weights are included.
